scenes.say: Not quite. APS and TEP pay only about six cents per kilowatt-hour for the solar you export.
So a typical system pays back in about twelve to fourteen years.
To make it pay faster: use more of your solar at home, consider west-facing panels, and size the system carefully.
And the state credit, twenty-five percent up to a thousand dollars, still applies.
Going solar in Arizona? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
